newsitem.title: GERMANY: Otto says not interested in buying Sears.
newsitem.headline: Otto says not interested in buying Sears.

text.p: German mail order group Otto Versand AG on Wednesday denied recent newspaper reports it was considering a break-up bid for Sears Plc to get hold of the troubled British retailer's catalogue business
A spokesman at the company's Hamburg headquarters said the reports were not new, and added that Otto had "no interest" in Sears' home shopping unit Freemans.

Otto, which is privately controlled, has been cited by British newspapers as a possible bidder even though Sears said in late March it had revived exclusive talks with Littlewoods on selling Freemans.
Sears on Monday restated its backing for chief executive Liam Strong, dismissing a report he could be axed over poor retail figures, a recent profits warning and drawn-out sales talks over Freemans.
